scope: Source road topology and approximate walking-reference distances; no entrance, live access or navigation validation.

checks.name: A U-shaped road follows all source corners instead of a direct line
Projected endpoints count only the used part of a source segment
Foot one-way forbids reverse travel even between projected endpoints
An exact endpoint may leave through a different adjacent road
Vehicle one-way does not block pedestrian reverse travel
Crossing geometries remain disconnected without a shared source node ID
Source-connected bridges and tunnels work only in the planning profile
Foot/access prohibitions and conditional restrictions are excluded
Blocked nodes, absent nodes and foot-restriction relations break connectivity
Steps retain their source geometry and flag
Out-of-coverage and invalid endpoints do not create connectors
Empty and incompatible datasets fail explicitly
Distance labels use the midpoint along road geometry
Frozen network bytes and original extract provenance match the manifest
Every displayed food point snaps to a nearby source road

Real route: tiedan-gangzi → jiankang-zhuer
